newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo 96 sugar beet, sunflower crops seen rising.
newsitem.headline: Yugo 96 sugar beet, sunflower crops seen rising.

text.p: Yugoslav 1996 sugar beet output is expected to rise 38 percent over last year's to 2.34 million tonnes, the Yugoslav Statistics Office said in its latest report on Friday.
The sugar beet area rose to 70,000 hectares from 62,000 in 1995, the report said.
Average yield per hectare was expected to be 33.6 tonnes, up some 6.2 tonnes from the average yield per hectare in 1995.
The report said the sunflower crop was expected to reach 401,000 tonnes, an increase of 36 percent over last year.
The sunflower area increased by around 35,000 hectares this year and estimated average yield per hectare was 1.97 tonnes.
Soybean production was also seen jumping 33 percent on last year to around 142,500 tonnes, with expected average yield per hectare 1.96 tonnes.
The statistics report was based on the state of crops in early September. -- Amra Kevic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 2224305
